caption: The drawing features a rectangular object that resembles a pouch or envelope, predominantly colored in green with red edges and trim. The main body of the object is green, while the interior lining and the flap are in a reddish-pink shade. There is a long, loose red ribbon attached, extending out from the pouch. The object includes interior compartments or dividers, visible through the open flap at the top. To the lower left, there is a smaller, monochrome pencil sketch of the same pouch in a closed state, tied with a ribbon. Both the main colored image and the smaller sketch are positioned against a plain, light beige background. The artist's name, Louella Long, and the year '37, are inscribed at the bottom left of the drawing.
title: Handbag
